events.title: Province names the first BC Parks Foundation board

evidence.source_title: Introducing the board of the new BC Parks Foundation
evidence.locator: Board list and initial endowment paragraph

events.interpretation_notes: The Province announced an initial $10 million in February. The independent Foundation had ten board members, chaired by Karla Rockwell.

events.title: Province and BC Parks Foundation sign a collaborative agreement

evidence.source_title: Ministry of Environment and Parks estimates notes, 2025

events.interpretation_notes: The agreement guides the independent charity’s relationship with BC Parks. The estimates notes give the month of signing.

events.title: Province announces a further $10 million for BC Parks Foundation

evidence.source_title: Province strengthens parks protection, nature conservation

events.interpretation_notes: The contribution supports the Foundation’s long-term work for parks.
